_comment: Data-driven topic list for Lane 6a. Edit this file to add/remove topics — NO rebuild required.  The first topic that matches a weekday/time window is triggered.  Each prompt is a single topic.  End-of-day check-in asks every topic (sequentially) unless `optional: true` + user said skip.

topics.title: Weekly Meeting
topics.prompt: Ada meeting mingguan harini? (Tajuk / perbincangan / keputusan)

topics.title: Project briefing
topics.prompt: Project briefing apa harini? (projek baru / brief klien / tukar spec)

topics.title: Discussion
topics.prompt: Discussion dengan team / supplier / site apa harini?

topics.title: Deal Supplier
topics.prompt: Deal supplier mana harini? (Nama supplier, item ordered, project)

topics.title: Production
topics.prompt: Production status harini? (Benda yang check / susun / semak)

topics.title: Logistic
topics.prompt: Logistic harini? (Urus item, rekod inventori, prepare material)

topics.title: Lalamove
topics.prompt: Lalamove / delivery book berapa trip harini?

topics.title: Item on site
topics.prompt: Item sampai site apa harini? (Nama item + kuantiti + project)

topics.title: Point learned
topics.prompt: Apa point yang saya dapat harini? (1 line je, atau '-')

topics.title: Halangan / isu
topics.prompt: Halangan / isu harini? (Tiada isu besar / real issue)

mondayMorning.prompt:
Senarai project aktif minggu ni (satu line setiap project).
Contoh:
- Surau Darul Dakwah
- Kediaman Puan Hashima

fridayAfternoon.prompt:
Kemaskini senarai project (siap / tamat / baru mulai)?
List semula semua project aktif hujung minggu ni.
